speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I asked for the monitoring hand off to fire automatically, so the system catches drift without waiting for a human. I also need formal sign off for any changes to the alerting rules, not just a casual nod.
output.correction: You are mixing up the automation of the hand off with the governance of the alerts. I want the hand off to be fully automated, but the alerting configuration requires a strict owner approval.
